news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 12%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2027 has deteriorated. 2027 revenue forecast decreased from ₹106.0b to ₹103.4b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹21.45 per share to ₹18.92 per share. Net income forecast to grow 12% next year vs 41% growth forecast for Real Estate industry in India. Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹829. Share price fell 6.8% to ₹567 over the past week.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with expectations, revenues disappoint
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹17.83 (up from ₹17.65 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹98.2b (up 23% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹44.1b (up 1.1% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 45% (down from 55% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 9.8%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 29% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 8% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.86 (up from ₹4.28 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹20.2b (up 32% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹12.0b (up 14% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 60% (down from 69% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 13%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 8.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 24% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 32% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 18% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
